intro: A Donation of Wool is a material requisition organized by the Gnomeregan Exiles to gather essential textile supplies. Displaced from their technological home city, the exiled gnomes rely on sixty pieces of wool cloth from generous adventurers across the realm to sustain their community. Contributing to the drive grants formal recognition among the gnome refugees.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Gnomeregan Exiles for your generous actions. Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.
If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, friend!
